'''February 2000 Boca Raton tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Lost Realms, Boca Raton, Florida on 6 February 2000. [[David Irvine]] won it. It is known from Mike Fitzgerald's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d227">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-06-d-d-d-d-d-dengar-boca-fl-2-6-00d227/ d-d-d-d-d-dengar-boca-fl-2-6-00], DeckTech (Mike "Iceman" Fitzgerald, 6 February 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-06-d-d-d-d-d-dengar-boca-fl-2-6-00d227/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 6 February 2000
* '''Site:''' Lost Realms, Boca Raton, Florida
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 13
* '''Winner:''' [[David Irvine]]
